book.title: Traction: Get a Grip on Your Business
book.author: Gino Wickman

confidence_note: Agenda from EOS Worldwide page; book wording not read. 12-hour claim dropped.
facts: Weekly, same day and time, start and end on time, 90 minutes.
Segue 5, Scorecard 5, Rock Review 5, Headlines 5, To-Do 5, IDS 60, Conclude 5.
First sections only report; off-track Rocks go to the issues list.
IDS: identify, discuss, solve, most important issue first, root cause.
Anyone can call tangent alert; meeting is rated at the end.
tension: Meetings that discuss everything and close nothing.

lessons.idea: Give a meeting a fixed order.

reflect_final: Which unresolved topic could a fixed structure close?

use_cases.move: First half hour reports only, then solve the top issue.
Tangent alert. Put it on the issues list.
Same hour each Sunday, solve one issue.

pocket_idea: Same day, same hour, reports first, then solving: a fixed order turns talk into decisions.

conversation_variants.punchline_idea: Ninety minutes, sixty of them solving.
